topics: 1D Signals  - A general introduction to real time signals - CT and DT signals
Unit impulse, step and ramp sequences
Representation of discrete time signals- (Graphical representation, Functional representation, Sequence representation)
Properties of DT Signals  - Even and Odd
Periodicity and Symmetry property of DT signals
DTFS - Determining the Fourier-Series Representation of a Sequence
Properties of Discrete-Time Fourier Series - Linearity
Discrete-Time Fourier Transform for Aperiodic Sequences - Properties of the Discrete-Time Fourier Transform (Periodicity
DTFT of periodic sequences - Frequency Spectra of Sequences
Characterizing LTI Systems Using the Fourier Transform.

Discrete time systems - Block diagram representation and mathematical representation of discrete-time systems-Some common elements of Discrete-time systems (adder, constant multiplier, signal multiplier, unit delay, unit advance)
Recursive DT systems and non recursive discrete time systems
Linearity and time invariance property of a DT system.
Discrete time LTI systems - Discrete time convolution
Characterizing LTI Systems and Convolution - Impulse  response of an LTI system
Properties of an LTI system - Causality
Eigen Sequences/ eigen functions for discrete-Time LTI Systems.
Z transform  - motivation for z transform
Relationship Between z Transform and Discrete-Time Fourier Transform
Region of Convergence for the z Transform.
Properties of z transform - Translation (Time Shifting)
Determination of the Inverse z Transform
Characterizing LTI systems using z transform
Transfer function of an LTI system.
Solving Difference Equations Using the Unilateral z Transform
Block Diagram Representation of Discrete-Time LTI Systems

courseOutcomes.description: Demonstrate the concept and different types of DT signals and the effect of different operations on the signals.
Explain how DTFS can be used to represent a periodic DT signal.
Apply the concept of DTFT for an aperiodic signal to determine the frequency spectrum.
Utilize the properties of a DT system based on its impulse response and z transform.
Identify the response of a DT LTI system to an arbitrary input sequence.
